Blackberry soda round 2 almost fully pressurized!

I typed out the whole recipe only for it to get lost when I uploaded the image. sigh

Amount Ingredient
300g Blackberries
200g Sugar
30mL Lemon juice
2L Water
1/4tsp Molasses
1/4tsp Pectin enzyme

Simmer blackberries, sugar, lemon juice in some water for 1/2 hour. Strain into fermenting vessel. Dilute with cold water to 2L. Add pectin enzyme. Start yeast in a splash of water with the molasses and some sugar. When the yeast foam starts, pitch into fermenter. When you see active fermentation, bottle and let stand at room temperature for 24 hours or until the (plastic) bottles are too firm to squish.

If you can't get pectin enzyme, mash or blend the blackberries and extract the flavour by letting them sit in water for 24 hours.

The molasses starter isn't tastable in the final product but it should prevent yeast malnutrition (a problem I noticed in prior batches).
